note: The voiceover script. 'say' is read by the voice ('Custom Domain' as two words). 'gap' is the silence after the line. scripts/vo_build.py places the lines and writes their starts into timeline.json.

lines.say: Here's the whole custom domain integration. Three calls.
One. On your server, create a short-lived widget token, with your API key.
Two. In your app, open the widget with that token.
Your customer signs in to their DNS provider, and approves. That's their whole job.
Three. We call your webhook the moment the domain is live.
Records written, checked, and HTTPS taken care of.
No DNS code. No certificate code. Just three calls.
Custom Domain. You never touch their DNS, or their certificates.
